'''Sabat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who acted as the chief of security for [[Attuma Duum]]. He was killed in personal combat by the rogue [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Shon-Ju]] in [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hold it&mdash;that's far enough! Duum wants to keep you alive, but ''I'' have no problem putting you down for good!''"<br />"''You know what...neither do I.|Sabat faces down Shon-Ju one last time|<ref name="Shon-Ju" />}}
Sabat was the friend and chief of security to the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]].<ref name="Shon-Ju" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011" /> he was assigned to hunt down the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]]. He [[Skirmish in the Cavamina Minor cantina|ambushed]] Secura and her [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] and forced her to flee. Sabat led his mercenaries to the crashsite of Secura's [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor]], and the Jedi ran away again. Pursuing her into the forest, Sabat's men were ambushed by the rogue [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Shon-Ju]] and his students. Consternated, Sabat ordered his men to fire at the new arrivals, yet the students charged forth and subdued the mercenaries. Shon-Ju himself took out a [[Attuma Duum's security droid|security droid]] then turned his attention to Sabat, asking if it was a good day to die. Replying in the negative, Sabat activated his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and escaped.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

Sabat returned to [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]] while Shon-Ju attended to the wounded Secura on the moon below. Sabat met with his employer. Soon, Secura and Shon-Ju stole two abandoned [[Unidentified bomber|bombers]] and flew up to Duum's base hidden in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid field]]. They snuck aboard to arrest Duum, but Shon-Ju deliberately tripped the alarm. Secura used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to subdue the guards, but Sabat took Shon-Ju hostage and threatened to kill him; Secura surrendered. Once imprisoned, Duum came to visit the two Force-sensitives, but soon left to attend to [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|other matters]]. Sabat stayed behind to guard the prisoners, and Duum offered to patch in a feed so Sabat can watch the battle. When Sabat was distracted, Shon-Ju used his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to break free. Sabat pulled a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on him and said he had no problems [[Death/Legends|killing]] Shon-Ju. Shon-Ju reciprocated, tossing the mercenary into a turbine, causing an explosion which disabled the station's shields. Shon-Ju then moved to attack Duum; Secura broke free in time to save Duum. She and Shon-Ju started grappling with each other; he was about to kill the Jedi when she cut off his hands. The three fighters managed to escape before the station exploded as a result of asteroid crashes.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You pay me to run this station's security, to ''protect'' you. You don't take these constant attempts on your life seriously&mdash;but ''I'' do.''"<br />"''A bit ''too'' seriously, my friend. I've been killed once. It didn't take.|Sabat to Duum|<ref name="Shon-Ju" />}}
By the time of the Clone Wars, he had acquired a scar across his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. When faced with a choice between death and running away, Sabat chose to flee. He had a tendency to enjoy violence and was not afraid to threaten a hostage. He took his role as Duum's chief of security seriously, and was seen by Duum as paranoid or just dedicated. Sabat wore a set of armor similar to that of [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone troopers']] and used a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and periodically employed a jetpack. He wore his hair long and in braids, and over his shoulders he placed a furry cape.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sabat appears in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''. For his appearance, he was drawn by [[Brian Koschak]].
